raw_segments.text: Shylock, what judgment shall I dread, doing no wrong?
You have among you many a perchesed slave, which, like your asses and your dogs and mules,
you use in abject and enslavish parts because you bought them.
Shall I say to you, let them be free, marry them to your heirs?
Let their beds be made as soft as yours, and let their pallets be seasoned with such viands.
You will answer, the slaves are ours.
The pound of flesh which I demand of him is dearly bought.
Tease mine and I will have it.
If you deny me, fight upon your law.
There is no force in the decrees of Venice.
